title: Senior Mobile Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
As a **Senior Mobile Engineer** (m/f/d) at EVENTIM, your expertise helps to create seamless experiences that delight **millions of fans worldwide**. We look for people who go beyond building features, understand mobile systems end\-to\-end, think across platforms, and **leverage Agentic AI** to improve how software is built.


This role is for experienced engineers willing to take **ownership for outcome,** shape architecture, and are comfortable operating in a modern, cross\-platform environment powered by **Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).**


**What to expect:**

* Design, build, and evolve our mobile applications across **iOS and/or Android**
* Drive and shape our **Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP)** architecture and shared code strategy
* **Own technical decisions**, code quality, and long\-term maintainability
* Leverage **Gen AI tools** (e.g. **Claude Code**), deeply integrated into your development workflow
* Collaborate closely with product, design, backend teams and stakeholders to deliver exceptional user experiences
* Contribute to a strong engineering culture and evolve good practices by **mentoring engineers**

**What you’ll need:**


* Strong track record of shipping professional Apps in **iOS (Swift)** **and/or** **Android (Kotlin)** for tens of thousands of users
* Your **AI\-first mindset** allows you to master Gen AI as a true multiplier, for all aspects of the SDLC
* You mastered creating your own skills and drive **spec\-driven development** across your team
* Deep understanding of mobile architectures, including all aspects of end\-to\-end app lifecycle
* Skilled in scaling and optimizing, including mastering debugging of cross\-platform Apps
* Proven ability to facilitate and communicate **architectural decisions** across teams
* Able to onboard others to modern engineering practices and processes (**Git, CI/CD, testing strategies**, etc.)
* Helpful: Hands\-on experience with **Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP)** or strong interest in building cross\-platform shared logic


We value diversity and treat all applications equally – regardless of gender, background, age, religion, disability, or sexual orientation. Different perspectives enrich our team and make EVENTIM stronger.
